proposals.expected_signal: Higher frozen full-sort NDCG@10 from better tail-item discrimination and less popularity-dominated propagation, with gains concentrated in medium-degree users/items.
proposals.failure_mode: Degree-aware residual weighting may under-propagate strong collaborative signals on dense nodes, causing weaker top-rank precision if the contrastive auxiliary over-separates near-neighbor positives.
proposals.hypothesis: If LightGCN propagation is refined with degree-aware residual mixing and a contrastive auxiliary on stochastic edge-drop views, then embeddings will preserve core collaborative structure while reducing oversmoothing, improving ranking utility on ML-1M without changing the evaluation protocol.
